Message:
KVM: s390: split SIE state guest prefix field

This patch splits the SIE state guest prefix at offset 4
into a prefix bit field. Additionally it provides the
access functions:

 - kvm_s390_get_prefix()
 - kvm_s390_set_prefix()

to access the prefix per vcpu.
